items.desc: Choose your inadequately prepared racer, and disregard severe consequences in your desperate pursuit of short-lived victory.

items.name: Mouthwashing
items.sub: Wrong Organ · Psychological Horror, Story Rich, Horror
items.desc: The five crew members of the Tulpar are stranded in the empty reaches of space, shrouded in perpetual sunset. God is not watching.

items.desc: 《方块战场 Block Battlefield》 is a light Roguelike game that combines real-time falling blocks with auto-battler combat. By clearing blocks, you can deploy soldiers, choose random upgrades, and break through enemy fortresses. Build your block army and push your limits on an ever-changing battlefield!

items.name: Sack Investigation
items.sub: Code Junction Cons · Action, Adventure, Casual
items.desc: Sack Investigation an online multiplayer co-op casual puzzle platforming game. Join with up to 7 of your friends to explore and investigate the innerworkings of a magical and whimsical wizard tower. Find and destroy the cursed objects to progress and upgrade your Sack.

items.name: Archives of Disorder - Pasture Without Light
items.desc: Twelve years after humanity went blind in one second, survivors live by gentle rules in Haven Seven. Rations always arrive. Names on the list quietly disappear, and sound engineer Elias Ward finds the list has been altered. A narrative adventure about sight, memory and choice.

items.name: 颂声·市井小神仙
items.sub: 乱码飞映 · Casual, RPG, Simulation
items.desc: This isn’t a wealth game, but an immersive experience warming ordinary town life. From mending the first tile to managing the street’s economic lifeline, every choice reshapes the town’s dawn and dusk. As the inn’s lanterns glow at dusk, your The Moonlit Scroll unfolds slowly...

items.name: CLOUD PATROL
items.desc: Fly across floating islands, hold off swarming drones, and face down three colossal bosses. Earn coins, unlock stronger firepower, and climb the endless Ascension ladder. This sky is yours to guard. Dive into a fast, exhilarating wave-based first-person aerial shooter.
